course_description: This course provides fundamental mathematical structure and logical principles that are important to computer science and develops a deeper understanding of the computing problems that require mapping to permutations, combinations of a set, modular arithmetic reasoning, and counting techniques. The course explains a set theory and advanced counting techniques, graphs, and complex applications to solve challenging problems related to the subject with real-world applications.

course_learning_outcomes.text: demonstrate the application of discrete structures in different fields of computer science;
evaluate Boolean functions and simplify expressions using properties of Boolean algebra;
explain some of the concepts of number theory;
analyze the fundamentals theorem of arithmetic;
apply counting techniques in solving arithmetic and counting problems;
understand graphs, trees, and their applications;
apply mathematical arguments and reasoning in proving mathematical statements; and
demonstrate 21st-century skills in all learning activities.
